verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Semantic Views as a schema-level database object where you declare business metrics and model entities and their relationships once (snowflake-docs-11, snowflake-docs-47). Cortex Analyst answers natural-language questions without SQL and can be exposed to AI agents through the managed MCP server (snowflake-docs-13, snowflake-docs-57). However, the evidence never explicitly states that Cortex Analyst or SQL queries resolve against the Semantic View. missing for 10: explicit documentation that queries and Cortex Analyst/AI tools consume Semantic Views for consistent answers, explicit mention of dimensions and join declarations, governance controls specific to semantic views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
